label: Nov 27, 2026 (morning)
title: LinkedIn Digest — Nov 27, 2026 (AM)
source: Quiet post-Thanksgiving feed: a short list, led by Andy Holt's 59M-row Tableau Data App.

items.author: Andy Holt, Nov 26, 10h ago
items.summary: Six-years-in-the-making Tableau Data App that ridge-plots 59M rows of UK crime data with on-the-fly aggregation level, parameters for peak height/scale and linked side-panel charts, built from a single-prompt recipe plus asset library. Argues enterprise use needs design guardrails/standardisation. 13 reactions, 5 comments.

items.author: Will Perkins (sharing Andy Holt), Nov 27, 7h ago
items.summary: Will Perkins reshares Andy Holt: a Tableau Data App .twbx can be unzipped to reveal embedded fonts/JS/CSS plus markdown files (spec, design, memories, README) that document decisions and change log, easing risk/control concerns about vibe-coded dashboards. 5 reactions, 3 comments.

items.author: Pankaj Namekar, Nov 26, 10h ago
items.summary: Polished 1920x1080 Power BI warehouse control tower: isometric floor with workload by zone, carrier cut-off timeline, action card, pick-face heat map, dock schedule; all HTML/SVG driven by DAX; live YouTube build planned. 27 reactions, 1 comment, 1 repost.

items.author: Trang N. Tran, Nov 26, 20h ago
items.summary: Argues data teams are betting on a few governed key dashboards while ad hoc questions move to agentic analytics; analysts own a knowledge/context layer, curated datasets, metric definitions and skill playbooks. Newsletter link. 48 reactions, 11 comments, 1 repost.

items.author: Dennis Demandaco, Nov 25, 2d ago
items.summary: Follow-up to his multi-agent BI delivery system: a 3-episode AI-voiced anime retelling a real run (human-approved scope, data fighting back, QA rejecting a dashboard, surprising answer on wait times vs satisfaction). 12 reactions, 2 comments, 2 reposts.

items.author: Külli Esko, Nov 26, 19h ago
items.summary: Announces her Makeover Monday-style "Talking Turkey" viz as Tableau Viz of the Day, using an autumnal palette and vertical Sankey flow for U.S. turkey production and exports. Dashboard link: [Tableau Viz of the Day](https://public.tableau.com/app/discover/viz-of-the-day) (Talking Turkey; direct URL not given in post). 20 reactions, 8 comments, 1 repost.

items.author: Ritesh Bisht, Nov 27, 6h ago
items.summary: Migrated a Tableau Executive Overview dashboard to Sigma via Claude prompts: KPIs matched, area charts wrong at first, fixed after re-prompt, human review still needed. Asks others about AI BI migration experience. 10 reactions, 2 comments.
